reason: The README describes a DSH Web client plugin whose primary purpose is switching built-in and custom image or video interface skins.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供内置主题以及自定义图片和视频背景皮肤。
summaries.en: Provides built-in themes and custom image or video background skins for the DSH Web interface.

capabilities: changes the DSH web client appearance with built-in themes
supports custom image and video backgrounds
installs and registers a local DSH web plugin
stores custom skin media in browser localStorage
